themes.name: Fork
themes.description: One piece attacks two targets at once — something has to give.

themes.name: Pin
themes.description: A piece can't move without exposing something more valuable behind it.

themes.name: Skewer
themes.description: Attack the big piece first — when it steps aside, win what was hiding behind it.

themes.name: Discovered Attack
themes.description: Move one piece and unmask another's attack — two threats from a single move.

themes.name: Double Check
themes.description: Two pieces check at once — the king must move, nothing else parries it.

themes.name: Back-Rank Mate
themes.description: The king is boxed in behind its own pawns — crash through on the last rank.

themes.name: Hanging Piece
themes.description: An undefended piece is up for grabs — spot it before your opponent saves it.

themes.name: Trapped Piece
themes.description: A piece has run out of safe squares — hem it in and win it.

themes.name: Deflection
themes.description: Drag a defender off its post, then strike where it used to guard.

themes.name: Attraction
themes.description: Lure a piece — often the king — onto a square where it walks into a tactic.

themes.name: Sacrifice
themes.description: Give up material now to force a bigger gain, or mate, right after.

themes.name: In-Between Move
themes.description: Slip in a forcing move before the 'obvious' recapture — the zwischenzug.

themes.name: Advanced Pawn
themes.description: A pawn near promotion does the work — push it, or use its threat.

themes.name: Defensive Resource
themes.description: You're under fire — find the only move that holds the position together.
